# javaabu/permissions

> Roles, permissions and policies for Laravel apps and packages, built on spatie/laravel-permission. Packages and apps register permissions, roles and default policies in code; `php artisan permissions:sync` writes them to the database. Permissions are grouped and have translatable descriptions; policies are overridable; everything works per guard with any number of user models. Includes role management routes, an overridable controller, a JSON API, and Blade (javaabu/forms) or Inertia React (@javaabu/forms) pages that work in Dhivehi and right to left. Role descriptions can be translated with javaabu/translatable.

Paths are relative to this file. In a project, that's vendor/javaabu/permissions/.

## Rules

- Register permissions with `Permissions::register()` or `Permissions::resource()` from `Javaabu\Permissions\Permissions`, in a service provider's `boot()`. Never create permissions with `Permission::create()` in migrations or seeders.
- Run `php artisan permissions:sync` after adding or changing permissions, and on every deploy after `migrate`. Registering alone doesn't touch the database.
- Name permissions `{action}_{resource}`: `view_exports`, `edit_exports`, `delete_exports`, `force_delete_exports`, `edit_others_exports`. The group is the resource (`exports`).
- Descriptions and group labels are English strings used as translation keys. Add their Dhivehi to `lang/dv.json`.
- Packages register default policies with `Permissions::policy(Model::class, Policy::class)`, never `Gate::policy()`, so apps can override them. Apps override with `config('permissions.policies')` or `Gate::policy()`.
- Extend `Javaabu\Permissions\Policies\ResourcePolicy` and set `$resource` for conventional policies. Add other abilities through `$abilities`, which maps an ability to a permission or a list of permissions (any of them).
- Type-hint users as `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model`. Don't assume `App\Models\User` or the `web` guard; guards come from `config('permissions.guards')`.
- User models use `Javaabu\Permissions\Traits\HasRoles`, not spatie's trait directly.
- Role routes come from `Route::roles(['guard' => 'web_admin'])` inside the app's route group; they aren't loaded automatically.
- Role names are ASCII identifiers (`editor`); role descriptions may be in Thaana.
- The role pages render with `config('permissions.views')`: `blade` (javaabu/forms v2 components, extending `permissions.layout`) or `inertia` (React pages `permissions::Roles/Index`, `Create`, `Edit`, `Show`, resolved with javaabu/manifest's `resolvePage()`). Override a Blade view with `vendor:publish --tag=permissions-views`, a React page with `php artisan manifest:override permissions js/Pages/Roles/Edit.tsx`.
- Use logical Tailwind utilities (`ms-`, `pe-`, `text-start`) in overridden views, never `ml-`/`text-left`.
- With javaabu/translatable, set `permission.models.role` to `Javaabu\Permissions\Models\Translatable\Role`; forms then send `description_en`, `description_dv`. Check support with `Javaabu\Permissions\Support\Translations::supportsRole()`, never by calling translatable classes directly.

- [Checking permissions](docs/basic-usage/checking-permissions.md): can(), anyPermission(), @anypermission, Permissions::check()
